text: I contacted CREDENCE RESOURCE MANAGEMENT, in regards to an XXXX account that was reporting on my report with a balance of XXXX. The rep I spoke with offered me a settlement amount of XXXX in which I paid and they advised that the account would be deleted off my report once the payment has been made. I tried to get the rep to send me information in writing to confirm that the account would be deleted once paymemtn is deleted and the rep advised that they do not send letters, and confirmed that our call was being recorded and assured me that it would be deleted. Upon checking my credit report the account status only lists as settlement and has not been deleted. I am requesting that the account be deleted per my discussion with the rep once payment was made.
